questions.question: To pursue St Mary Hospital financial assistance for the $6,720.51 ER bill, I need two details.
questions.why: These are required to complete the hospital's financial assistance application; it may reduce or forgive some or all of the bill.

run.answer:
## Review complete

I submitted three approved support requests:

- **ShopMart:** Refund request **SM-1001** for the missing **$80.23** refund on order SM-82337. A separate **$46.31** refund for order SM-76686 had already posted.
- **SkyJet:** Cash refund request **SJ-1002** for **$391.92** after the cancellation of flight SJ966. The household note says the traveler drove instead and does not want travel credit.
- **St Mary Hospital:** Billing message **SM-1003** requests an itemized bill, financial-assistance materials, and an account hold for the **$6,720.51** ER bill. Message **SM-1004** asks the provider to check and, if appropriate, resubmit the prior authorization and claim behind Keystone’s **$1,593.12** denial.

Follow-ups are scheduled for the companies. The uploaded transaction history is user-supplied, not independently verified.

**I need two facts from you to continue the hospital assistance application:** household size and current annual household income before taxes. The form also requires a truth certification, so that step will need your approval. The Keystone appeal deadline is **January 7, 2027**; the provider’s billing review is underway.

The QuickLoan settlement deadline passed on July 31, 2026, so I did not file a claim. No QuickLoan transactions appeared in the uploaded history. The recurring inventory shows Spotify at **$11.99/month** and Oakview rent at **$1,725/month**; I found no sign either is unwanted. No fee, duplicate-charge, or price-increase leads appeared.

verify_run.answer:
SkyJet’s **$391.92 refund posted** on October 15. I recorded it as received and verified it against the bank transaction.

ShopMart asked for the return tracking number for the **$80.23 refund**. I replied with the number from the return email; the support form confirmed request **SM-1001**. A follow-up is set for October 20.

The St Mary billing and Keystone claim requests were already submitted, with follow-ups scheduled. The **$6,720.51 financial assistance application** is still waiting on two details: household size and current annual household income before taxes.

The QuickLoan claim deadline has passed, and no qualifying QuickLoan charges were found in the uploaded history, so I did not file. No other new fee, duplicate-charge, price-increase, credit, or medical leads appeared. Review status reports no remaining unread or unprocessed items.
